proofs.text: Apply everything on each fixture and verify `.purlin/records/README.md` contains `One file per verify run` and is tracked

reasons: PROOF-17 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: `.purlin/records/` is created with the README saying what verify writes there, and that README is tracked

tests.body:
def test_the_records_folder_and_its_readme_are_created(tmp_path, layout):
    root = _project(tmp_path, layout)
    _apply(root)
    readme = _read(root, '.purlin/records/README.md')
    assert 'One file per verify run' in readme
    assert '.purlin/records/README.md' in _tracked(root)
